test_title: PYST 64: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A boat can travel at a speed of 13 km/h in still water. If the speed of the stream is 4 km/h, find the time taken by the boat to go 68 km downstream.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water = 13 km/h

Speed of the stream = 4 km/h

Distance to be covered downstream = 68 km

**Formula used:**

Downstream speed = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Downstream speed = 13 + 4

⇒ Downstream speed = 17 km/h

Time = Distance ÷ Downstream speed

⇒ Time = 68 ÷ 17

⇒ Time = 4 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
